name: BJC HealthCare MyChart
registration_note: For direct access in Clippi-Health, you register your own use of the app with Epic, supply the requested identity and data-use information, and accept Epic's terms. Save your production public client ID only in this local record store. It identifies your registered app, not your patient account; you sign in to MyChart separately. Clippi-Health does not supply a shared client ID.
registration_steps: Create your Epic on FHIR developer account and register your use of Clippi-Health for Patients, Incoming API, standalone OAuth, and FHIR R4.
Register the exact native-app callback http://127.0.0.1:8765/oauth/callback and the read-only patient APIs Clippi-Health uses.
Provide accurate information for your registration, complete Epic's Data Use Questionnaire, follow the sandbox testing checklist, and accept Epic's terms before marking your app Ready for Production.

Paste your production public client ID below to save it locally, then test against BJC MyChart. Saving the ID does not prove activation. If BJC does not receive it automatically, ask BJC to activate your client ID.
direct_note: Direct access is unavailable until you save your own Epic production public client ID in this local record store. The manual MyChart download above works without developer/app registration.
manual_export_steps: Sign in to BJC HealthCare & Washington University MyChart.
Open Your Menu, then choose Document Center.
Choose the record option that best matches the information you want and submit the request.
When MyChart says the record is ready, download it to this computer. Keep the download as a ZIP when MyChart supplies one.
Return to Clippi-Health and choose the downloaded ZIP or record folder.
